verdict.rationale: HumanLayer provides task diffs with a navigable changed-files tree (docs-30, docs-21). Draft pull requests are created only when the user asks the agent to open one from the GitHub tab or diff view (docs-19), so a human reviews the diff before any PR exists. Tasks also include a place for comments and review, and workflows are chosen for their review points (docs-5, docs-25). Missing for 10: an explicit approve/reject gate on diffs (approval here is implicit in user-triggered PR creation), in-depth docs on the diff review flow, and independent hands-on corroboration.
